behindTheArchitecture.lead: Hi, I'm the founder of aiAdaptiv.
body: I built this because boutique firms need powerful AI for contracts and client work — but public tools create serious risks. I only work with 6 partners at a time so I can give each one dedicated attention.

items.q: Why deploy inside my own cloud account?
items.a: True ownership. You control the account, billing, and keys. If you ever stop working with us, the entire platform stays yours — no vendor lock-in.

items.q: Do you see our sensitive data?
items.a: No. All processing happens inside your secure environment. We never have access to your prompts or documents.

items.q: What are the GPU compute costs?
items.a: You pay the cloud provider directly — never us. We stay elastic and can use different GPU providers, choosing and re-optimizing the right size for your usage. GPU compute typically runs a few hundred euros per month depending on how heavily you use it.
Usually 3–7 business days from payment to live, once you complete the onboarding checklist.
Yes. The monthly maintenance is cancelable with 30 days notice. You keep the platform you own.

qualifier.yes: you work with sensitive legal, financial, or client documents daily.
qualifier.no: you just need a cheap general AI tool.

terms.metaDescription: The terms governing aiAdaptiv's setup and maintenance services: ownership, fees, data handling, cancellation, and liability.
terms.intro: These terms govern the services aiAdaptiv ("we", "us") provides to the client ("Client", "you"). By ordering the setup service or paying the monthly maintenance fee, you agree to these terms.

body: aiAdaptiv provides custom configuration and maintenance services inside the Client's own cloud environment. We deploy an open-source AI platform (Open WebUI plus selected open-source models) into the Client's own EU-region cloud account, white-label it under the Client's domain (e.g. ai.yourfirm.com), and provide ongoing maintenance: model updates, security patches, and support.
We are flexible with serious design partners — specific open-source model preferences or specialized workflow needs are tailored during setup.

The Client owns the cloud account, the infrastructure, the keys, and the data. The platform is deployed inside the Client's own account, and it remains the Client's if the engagement ends. There is no vendor lock-in: if you stop working with us, the entire platform stays yours.
One-time Setup & Deployment: €1,999, due before deployment begins.
Monthly Maintenance & Support: €249 per month, billed monthly.

GPU and cloud infrastructure costs are paid by the Client directly to the cloud provider(s) and are not part of our fees. We remain provider-agnostic and help choose and optimize the right instance size for the Client's usage.

All processing happens inside the Client's secure environment. We do not have access to the Client's prompts or documents in the running platform. Any access credentials granted to us for deployment or maintenance are used solely to provide the services and are treated as confidential.
The Client is solely responsible for data inputs and for regulatory compliance applicable to the Client's use of the platform, including GDPR and the EU AI Act.
The Client is responsible for the cloud account itself, including billing with the cloud provider, and for completing the onboarding checklist needed to go live.
Typical deployment takes 3–7 business days from payment to live, once the onboarding checklist is complete. Timelines are estimates, not guarantees.

The monthly maintenance service is cancelable by either party with 30 days' notice. After cancellation the Client keeps the platform, the account, and the data; ongoing updates and support end with the notice period.
The one-time setup fee is non-refundable once deployment has been completed.

The service is provided "as-is", without warranties of any kind, express or implied, including fitness for a particular purpose. AI model outputs are probabilistic; the Client is responsible for reviewing outputs before relying on them.

To the maximum extent permitted by law, our total aggregate liability arising out of or related to the services is limited to the fees the Client has paid to us. We are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages, or for costs charged by third-party providers.

We may update these terms from time to time. The current version is always published on this page; material changes will be communicated to active clients. Continued use of the maintenance service after a change constitutes acceptance.

hero.subhead: AI SaaS products, mobile apps, automations, pilots, marketing systems and private LLM platforms. We design them, build them, and keep them running.

capabilities.lead: Six practices, one senior team. Every one of them has been shipped into production for a paying client — none of it is a capability slide.

items.title: AI SaaS products
items.body: We design and ship complete AI products: architecture, the model layer, auth, billing and the interface your customers actually use. From an empty repo to paying users.

items.title: Mobile apps
items.body: Native and cross-platform apps with AI at the centre — on-device where privacy or latency demands it, cloud where it doesn't. Shipped to the App Store and Play Store, not parked in TestFlight.

items.title: AI automations
items.body: Agents and workflows that do the work rather than describe it: intake triage, research, drafting, data entry — plus the integrations that push the output into the systems you already run.

items.title: AI pilots & case studies
items.body: A scoped pilot that answers one question: does AI actually pay back here? You get a working proof of concept, real numbers on cost and quality, and a written case for or against building further.

items.title: AI marketing
items.body: Growth systems run by AI: lead sourcing and enrichment, personalised outbound that survives a reply, content engines, and the reporting that shows which part actually worked.

items.title: AI app factory
items.body: A production line for internal tools — shared stack, shared components, one repeatable process — so the fifth app costs a fraction of the first. For teams that need ten things built, not one.

items.body: Every engagement gets a written scope, a timeline and a fixed price before anything starts. No hourly billing, no scope creep, no invoice you did not see coming.

process.h2: From first call to running system
process.lead: Four steps. You know the price and the scope before step three.

steps.title: Mapping call
steps.body: A free 30-minute session. We map where your team loses hours, which of it AI can actually take, and what the compliance constraints are.

steps.title: Scope & fixed price
steps.body: A written scope, an architecture sketch, a timeline and one fixed price. If it is not worth building, we will tell you that instead.

steps.title: Build & deploy
steps.body: We build in your cloud account with weekly demos of working software. You see the system before it is finished, not a status report about it.

steps.title: Run or hand over
steps.body: Documentation and training so your team owns it — or an optional retainer where we monitor, update and keep improving it.
